posting:
JOB TITLE
AI Engineer, Product

COMPANY
Brex

JOB LOCATION
San Francisco, California, United States

WORK ARRANGEMENT
Hybrid. Three coordinated in-office days per week: Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Up to four weeks per year of fully remote work are available as a perk.

APPLICATION STATUS
Applied approximately four weeks ago.

COMPANY OVERVIEW
Brex is an intelligent finance platform that helps companies manage spending through corporate cards, banking, spend management, bill pay, and travel software. Its platform serves customers in more than 200 markets and aims to improve financial visibility, control spending, and reduce manual expense and accounting work through AI-powered automation and customer service. Customers include DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

AI AT BREX / TEAM CONTEXT
AI Engineering at Brex builds intelligent and autonomous systems integrated into the Brex platform. These AI agents are designed to do more than provide insights: they can take actions, optimize spending, manage workflows, and support real-time decisions. The team combines proprietary financial data with product and platform infrastructure to automate complex financial operations.

ROLE SUMMARY
The AI Engineer, Product will work as a product engineer on Brex's Audit Agent, an agentic system that reviews customer spending at scale and reduces manual work traditionally performed by business process outsourcing (BPO) teams. The role focuses on the product harness around the agent: workflows, user interfaces, data flows, system integrations, and feedback mechanisms that make agent outputs trustworthy and actionable for customers and reviewers.

The engineer will work across backend and frontend, with most work focused on backend system design, data modeling, and API design, alongside a meaningful amount of customer-facing UI development. The role requires close collaboration with engineers responsible for agent design and customer-facing experiences.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
- Build and ship customer-facing production features, from initial concept through rollout and iteration based on customer feedback.
- Design and maintain data contracts between the AI agent and Brex's financial system of record.
- Develop and improve feedback and evaluation loops to gather product signals and use them to improve agent behavior, interfaces, and workflows.
- Run experiments involving user interface flows, prompt-driven product changes, and new review modes; use data to guide decisions.
- Speak directly with customers and reviewers, incorporate their feedback into product decisions, and help prioritize the team's next work.
- Design backend systems, data models, and APIs.
- Build frontend features when needed to solve customer and reviewer problems.
- Collaborate across agent engineering, frontend engineering, product, and other teams.
- Translate ambiguous product needs into shipped features and challenge designs when necessary to improve the overall user experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Demonstrated experience shipping customer-facing features end-to-end across both backend and frontend.
- Ability to take ownership across technical layers rather than handing work off between teams.
- Strong product mindset, with a focus on users, workflows, and outcomes.
- Comfort working with ambiguity and communicating directly with customers.
- Strong bias toward action and experience building or shipping products when requirements are not fully specified.
- Ability to collaborate across team boundaries and constructively challenge decisions related to agent design, user experience, and data models.
- Strong backend engineering foundation, including system design, data modeling, and API design.
- Willingness and ability to build UI features directly when needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS / BONUS POINTS
- Experience at an early-stage startup or on a small team with end-to-end ownership of a product area.
- Experience building products with large language models (LLMs) or agentic systems, especially evaluation, tracing, feedback loops, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
- Experience in fintech, compliance, auditing, fraud prevention, or other domains requiring review workflows and traceability.
- Experience building products around non-deterministic systems, where product design and controls must account for variable outputs.
- A track record of helping teams unblock projects spanning backend, frontend, and other systems.

COMPENSATION
Expected base salary range: $171,000–$240,000 USD. Starting base pay depends on factors such as location, skills, experience, market demand, and internal pay parity. Equity or other forms of compensation may be included depending on the position.

COMPANY LEGAL INFORMATION
Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.

RECRUITING / SECURITY NOTICE
Brex recruiters will contact candidates through LinkedIn or email addresses using the brex.com domain. Job seekers should ignore outreach claiming to be from Brex through other sources, as it may be malicious.
